name: 20024 · Washington, DC
findings: ZIP 20024 (Washington) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20024 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20024 (Washington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 84 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
